description: Mute or unmute a video layer's baked audio (silenced in both preview and export). The processing pipeline's audio-split step sets this true after demuxing the clip's audio into a standalone overlay track (NLE-style linked A/V), so the source audio doesn't double with the overlay. Pass muted:false to restore the baked audio.

muted.description: true silences the layer's baked audio; false restores it.

projectId.description: Opaque project id (a v4 UUID, from list_projects/create_project). Selects which existing project this call mutates.
